response.description:
LLM Speech in
Microsoft Foundry brings advanced large language model capabilities to speech,
delivering transcription and translation with unmatched fluency and contextual
awareness. With enhanced
multilingual support and advanced prompt tuning, this API adapts to diverse
business needs and outperforms competitors in key benchmarks, providing
enterprise-grade speech intelligence and customization.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: LLM Speech in Microsoft Foundry
